_howto: PCC Technology public election reporting sites, polled by server/src/adapters/pccct.js. base = the site's ng-app/data folder; electionId from {base}/Elections.json. Files: {base}/election/{id}/Version.json, then {base}/election/{id}/{Version}/Electiondata.json + Lookupdata.json. Reporting is by town; county units are built only because Lookupdata.json itself maps every town to its county (countyTowns). Set enabled:false to stop polling one without deleting it.

elections.name: Connecticut 2026 State Election (Secretary of the State)
elections.note: No U.S. Senate race in CT in 2026. The only ballot questions are town charter questions (no statewide measure). Fusion voting: a candidate's party lines are summed into one choice (the source's own candidateGrouping does the same statewide).
